title: logDose delegates to the shared DoseLogging function
name: logDose
description: Replaces the inline timing/insert/schedule logic (now duplicated in DoseLogging.logDose, task-001) with a thin call into it, so the ViewModel path and the notification-action path (LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver, task-012) share one implementation instead of two copies of the same business logic.
acceptance_criteria: Signature (parameter list) is unchanged from the phase9 version, including notifyOnNextDose: Boolean

The body calls DoseLogging.logDose(...) inside viewModelScope.launch, passing context = getApplication(), the three repositories already held as fields, and notifyOnNextDoseOverride = notifyOnNextDose
onResult(outcome) is called with whatever DoseLogging.logDose returns
No timing/insert/scheduling logic is duplicated here anymore
exact_code:
fun logDose(
        profileId: Int,
        medicationId: Int,
        givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
        doseAmount: String,
        acknowledgeWarning: Boolean,
        notifyOnNextDose: Boolean,
        onResult: (LogDoseOutcome) -> Unit,
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val outcome = DoseLogging.logDose(
                context = getApplication(),
                doseLogRepository = doseLogRepository,
                medicationRepository = medicationRepository,
                settingsRepository = settingsRepository,
                profileId = profileId,
                medicationId = medicationId,
                givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
                doseAmount = doseAmount,
                acknowledgeWarning = acknowledgeWarning,
                notifyOnNextDoseOverride = notifyOnNextDose,
            )
            onResult(outcome)
        }
    }
